name: Sheet
description: Base UI modal shell: a mobile bottom sheet with 16px top corners and square bottom corners, and a right-aligned full-height desktop panel with square corners. Includes a fixed header, scrolling content, optional footer, and child-view back navigation.

figma.notes: Extracted from maintained PDP and search filter implementations. No standalone Figma binding is assigned yet.

description.description: Optional supporting copy below the title, inside the fixed header above its divider. Linked with aria-describedby. Omission preserves the original header.

open.description: Controlled visibility. Closed sheets unmount their content.

title.description: Visible heading and accessible dialog name.

closeLabel.description: Localized accessible label for the close action.

onClose.description: Request to close; the consumer must set open to false.

back.description: Replaces Close with Back in a child view. Escape also goes back; the backdrop closes the whole sheet.

size.description: Mobile content height starts at 50dvh and grows to the visible viewport minus its top safe area, with at least 48px reserved. Full height fills that maximum. Desktop defaults to a 480px full-height panel at the right edge.

contentPadding.description: Use compact for 8px content insets or none for lists that own their row padding.

desktopPlacement.description: Desktop presentation defaults to right; center remains for existing callers. Mobile geometry is unchanged.

initialFocus.description: Overrides the default close/back focus target for a custom header.

finalFocus.description: Explicit return target for shortcut-driven or custom navigation flows.

footer.description: Caller-owned actions outside the scrolling content, with bottom safe-area protection.

children.description: Business content. Sheet does not own selection or draft state.

radii.note: Below 1024px, top corners use --radius-surface-sheet (16px) and bottom corners are square. From 1024px, the default right-edge panel has square corners; explicit center uses --radius-surface-default (12px). Applies to both content and full sizes.

focus.note: Uses Button focus rings, confines Tab navigation, and restores the opener on close.

tapTarget.note: Close/back controls are visually 32px with centered 24px close icons and 20px back arrows and Button's 44px hit-area extender.

accessibility.ariaPattern: Base UI modal dialog labelled by its visible h2 and optional fixed description
accessibility.interaction: Base UI manages background isolation, focus trapping/restoration, outside dismissal, Escape and scroll locking. Child views focus Back, reset body scroll and intercept Escape to return to the parent.

testing.rationale: Showcase and browser tests cover focus, scrolling, backdrop dismissal, child navigation, Drawer motion, nested popovers and responsive consumers.
